notes.title: v0.1.4 Patch
notes.content: [p]Patch Notes June 6, 2025[/p][p]RELEASE: BETA[/p][p]VERSION: 0.1.4[/p][p]- Terrain system now uses Godot's RenderingServer API. This should give better multi-threaded performance[/p][p]- Terrain physics system upgraded, now using PhysicsServer API[/p][p]- Tree branch visuals slightly upgraded with some beveling, and fixed UV mapping[/p][p]- Tree branches now bend and move slightly as you move through dense forest. This isn't perfect but its a start on the visual upgrades that are coming[/p][p]- Gamepad controller bindings now use left and right bumpers to toggle through the tools. This should be a big improvement on controller support[/p][p]- Various UI upgrades, including UI tooltips and improved tutorial messages[/p]

tags.feature: - Terrain system now uses Godot's RenderingServer API. This should give better multi-threaded performance
- Terrain physics system upgraded, now using PhysicsServer API

tags.bug: - Tree branch visuals slightly upgraded with some beveling, and fixed UV mapping

tags.feature: - Tree branches now bend and move slightly as you move through dense forest. This isn't perfect but its a start on the visual upgrades that are coming
- Gamepad controller bindings now use left and right bumpers to toggle through the tools. This should be a big improvement on controller support
- Various UI upgrades, including UI tooltips and improved tutorial messages

notes.title: v0.1.3 Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes May 28, 2025
RELEASE: BETA
VERSION: 0.1.3

- Added hatchet game icon in taskbar
- Adjusted energy stat mechanic. The energy decrease is now non-linear and slows down once you fall below 10%. This reflects more real world scenarios, where you can go a long time without eating
- Adjusted HP stat mechanic for energy. Once energy is below the critical threshold (5% currently) you start to lose HP. Basically, you can die from starvation now
- Controller support added, with full keyboard mappings. There are two mapping slots provided for each action
- Tutorial improved, fire mechanic graphic made more clear
- Tutorial support for controllers, icons added to give more visual clarity
- Inventory bug fixed with picking up large logs
- "Place Bough" menu item renamed to "Green Bough" to be consistent with other items ("Place" doesn't appear anywhere else)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603517/9059d2af924e06c777d94eafc74828c2e1896adb.png[/img]

notes.title: v0.1.2 Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes May 24, 2025
RELEASE: BETA
VERSION: 0.1.2

- Inventory panel now includes a carry limit. This should help players to understand when they are carrying too many logs or too much firewood
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603517/88e4fb59c7499e86c73c86e7a262d153613eeaa7.png[/img]
- Icon for the "action hold" mechanic is cleaned up and a bit more clear now
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45603517/fcafd8cda96c0e6756e60d0d8e1b80187258a981.png[/img]
- Bug fix for picking up logs (scenario: picking up a log without cutting into a smaller log would cause a crash)
- Bushcraft Guide item added for "Carry Limit"
- Bug fix - leaderboard numbered list, all entries showed up as "1"

notes.title: v0.1.1 Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes May 22, 2025
RELEASE: BETA
VERSION: 0.1.1

- Fixed bug where you would still get wet while being inside a cabin
- Fixed sleeping bug, where if you got the "tired" status effect, it would stay 
- Tutorial messages updated
- Bug fixed where tutorial state was not cleared between rounds of the game
- Cleaned up leader board loading screen,
- Fixed crash at end of the level,
- Fixed glitch with using the Steel Pot
